Committed: Sobriety Tracker

A sobriety tracker for your iPhone.

Choose your start date and see the time you’ve kept. Committed gives your sober days a place on your phone, from your first milestone to the ones you create yourself.

Download Committed What’s included

Free to use with no time limit. Optional Lifetime Unlock adds premium features for $4.99 in the US, paid once.

iOS 18.6 or later · English and Spanish. Coming to Mac with version 3.0.

Make the count yours

Pick the view you want to come back to.

Matrix turns your days into dots. Sky builds a constellation as time passes. Ledger gives you a detailed readout of your elapsed time.

You can track sobriety, quitting nicotine, time away from social media, or another commitment. Choose the wording and visual style that fit.

Free to use

Track for free. Add premium features if you want.

Committed has no subscription or ads.

Free tracking

Enter your start date and keep track of your progress for as long as you like. No purchase is required, and there is no trial period.

Lifetime Unlock $4.99 USD

An optional one-time purchase adds these premium features:

  • Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
  • Apple Watch app and complications
  • Multiple commitments and hidden commitments with Face ID
  • Custom milestones
  • Private iCloud backup

US price shown. Your App Store shows the price for your region.

View on the App Store

Apple Watch

Your count, on your wrist.

Open the Watch app to check your commitments and milestones, or add a complication to a supported watch face. Apple Watch support is included with Lifetime Unlock and requires watchOS 11.0 or later.

See Committed on Apple Watch

Your information

Use it without creating an account.

Your commitments stay on your devices. If you enable backup, Committed uses your private iCloud account. David Jabech, the developer, cannot view your commitments or retrieve your backup.

The app contains no ads, analytics, or social feed. Hidden commitments can be protected with Face ID.

Read the privacy policy or get support.
